title: Guess Duel Beta
tagline: Hide a number and use A/B clues to deduce the other code.
metaDescription: Play Guess Duel free in your browser on one device, against the computer or by passing links between two phones. Recommended for ages 8+. Beta.

data.description: Choose a secret of three or four distinct digits. Take turns guessing: A means a correct digit in the correct position; B means a correct digit elsewhere. Play on one device, against the computer, or by passing links between two phones.
howToPlay: Choose three or four different digits as your secret; a leading zero is allowed.
Take turns guessing. Use A for a correct digit in the correct position and B for a correct digit elsewhere.
On a shared device, look away while the other player enters a secret. You can also choose the computer opponent or exchange relay links.

cover.alt: Guess Duel number tiles and A/B clues

faq.question: Can two people share one phone?
faq.answer: Yes. Take turns and look away while the other person enters a secret or passes the privacy screen.

faq.question: Can I play alone?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose the computer opponent. Three digits are a gentler start; four give you more to keep track of.

faq.question: Can we play on separate phones?
faq.answer: Relay mode passes a link or QR code after a turn. Each device keeps its own secret. Room-code access depends on AppAI origin approval and is not promised by publishing this page.

faq.question: What age is it for?
faq.answer: We suggest ages 8 and up, with help understanding the A/B clues. The 7+ metadata category is a broad rating; our play recommendation is 8+.
